verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Pipedream MCP only as a tool-calling surface: agents call actions on behalf of users with managed auth. The only related item is a catalog count ('46 actions · 4 triggers') on one app page. Nothing documents how an agent subscribes to downstream app events, registers webhooks, or receives pushed events through the MCP server, so the subscribe-instead-of-poll capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
